baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus pairs حَدَآئِقَ (ح د ق) with أَعْنَٰبًا (ع ن ب).
baseline_models.mechanism: The enclosed-garden branch gives the first noun a protected spatial boundary, while vine fruit gives that bounded space a cultivated yield. The pair therefore describes a productive habitat rather than two decorative objects.

activation_trace.role: The walled or otherwise bounded grove supplies the protected spatial container of the model.
Vine fruit supplies the concrete cultivated yield held by that container.

changed_reading.before: Gardens and grapes are adjacent items in a reward list.
changed_reading.after: The phrase presents bounded cultivation: a protected growing place identified through its fruit-bearing yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The garden noun retains ح د ق branch resonances of encircling, the eye, and concentrated looking.
baseline_models.mechanism: Encirclement turns the garden into an immersive surround, while the eye and intense-gaze branches make the fruit-filled scene a perceptual event that holds attention. This is a secondary root resonance, not a replacement of the garden sense.

activation_trace.role: Encircling supplies an immersive spatial relation between the garden and its beneficiary.
The eye branch supplies a perceptual register latent in the same focus root.
Intense looking makes the visible abundance an attention-fixing display.
Recognizable vine fruit gives the gaze a concrete focal object.

changed_reading.before: The phrase only inventories what is present.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can also stage how abundance is encountered: it surrounds the beneficiary and arrests the gaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence prepares and stabilizes a habitat, delivers water into it, brings hidden growth outward, and ends in interwoven gardens. Against that process, the focus garden and grapes become a renewed terminal yield of an ordered regenerative system, not static scenery.

activation_trace.role: The bounded grove anchors the process in the focus as a prepared receiving and growing space.
Vine fruit anchors the process in the focus as its mature, edible yield.
Preparation and leveling supply the fitted substrate on which the productive system can operate.
Peg-like fixity supplies environmental stabilization rather than fruit appearing without conditions.
Delivered descent supplies the directional transfer of water into the prepared habitat.
Water conveyed by pouring supplies the material input that enables cultivation.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from latent fertility to visible produce.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the growth phase of the causal chain.
A grove hidden by its own trees supplies the earlier garden endpoint resumed by the focus.
Intertwining vegetation supplies density and mutual enclosure at the process endpoint.

structural_cues: The ordered first-person making sequence in 78:6-16 moves from prepared ground and stabilization to delivered water and extracted growth.
The purpose construction at 78:15 and the garden endpoint at 78:16 make production, rather than mere scenery, the local pattern later resumed at 78:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preparation, fixity, delivered water, emergence, vegetation, and intertwined gardens; I supply the arrow that these conditions form one regenerative chain whose renewed yield is the focus grapes. A live alternative is that 78:32 begins a distinct reward catalogue and only echoes, rather than continues, the earlier production sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus names a completed garden scene.
changed_reading.after: The focus names the mature output of a repeatedly ordered water-to-growth system, with grapes marking realized fertility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the reward section, the overhead closure opens into entrances and the apparently solid mountains are displaced into mirage. The focus then reinstates reliable boundedness at the scale of a living garden, making enclosure itself part of the reward after ordinary cosmic boundaries fail.

activation_trace.role: The enclosed grove anchors the changed reading in a newly dependable living boundary.
The opening of what was closed supplies the loss of an ordinary enclosing surface.
Entrances multiply the permeability of the opened sky and sharpen the boundary reversal.
Removal and displacement supply the loss of the landscape's fixed masses.
The water-like mirage supplies an unreliable appearance against which the garden's material enclosure stands.

structural_cues: The matched passive transformations in 78:19-20 each culminate in فَكَانَتْ, converting sky and mountains into permeable or insubstantial forms.
The bounded garden appears only after this collapse sequence and the intervening judgment scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, entrances, displacement, mirage, and the focus's enclosed-garden branch; I infer a counter-topology in which reward restores trustworthy bounded space. The live alternative is simple temporal succession: cosmic collapse and garden enclosure may belong to separate scenes without a restorative relation.

changed_reading.before: A garden enclosure is an ordinary horticultural feature.
changed_reading.after: The enclosure can function as eschatologically renewed spatial reliability after sky and mountain boundaries become open or illusory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah gives the transgressors a return-place, then gives those who protect themselves a mafāz whose branch can hold both rescue and a perilous expanse. The immediately following enclosed garden and grapes concretize successful arrival: protected, provisioned destination replaces exposed passage.

activation_trace.role: The enclosed grove supplies the protected destination that resolves exposed passage.
Cultivated fruit supplies proof that the destination sustains rather than merely shelters.
Return to an appointed place supplies the negative destination against which the focus is differentiated.
Protection from harm supplies the beneficiary relation matched by the garden's enclosure.
The mafāza branch poised between rescue and deadly exposure supplies threshold geography rather than victory as a bare abstraction.

structural_cues: The parallel destination phrases لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًا and لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا align the two outcomes before the focus specifies the positive scene.
The focus's accusative pair immediately follows مَفَازًا, allowing destination or content specification without requiring a final syntactic choice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed destinations, protection, an ambivalent mafāza branch, enclosure, and fruit; I supply the passage-to-refuge arrow and treat the focus as the concrete geography of successful arrival. A live alternative is that mafāz means abstract success and the next items are merely independent rewards.

changed_reading.before: Gardens and grapes are possessions awarded after success.
changed_reading.after: They are the spatial and nutritive form of success itself: arrival from dangerous exposure into protected abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punitive scene denies cooling and drink, permits only hot fluid, and makes tasting an imposed ordeal; the reward sequence answers with fruit and a cup filled to its top. Grapes thus participate in restored bodily hospitality, reversing deprivation and hostile ingestion without requiring that the grapes be identified with the cup's contents.

activation_trace.role: Edible vine fruit anchors the reversal in a wholesome focus object available for nourishment.
Experiencing something as an ordeal supplies the negative bodily mode that the reward scene reverses.
Denied coolness supplies the missing bodily relief answered by cultivated abundance.
Denied normal drinking establishes deprivation in the same ingestive domain as fruit and cup.
Hot water supplies the hostile substitute for ordinary refreshment.
The cup with its contents restores offered drinking on the positive side of the sequence.
Fullness to the top changes deprivation into unwithheld provision.

structural_cues: The negative and exception pattern in 78:24-25 constricts bodily experience, whereas the coordinated accusatives in 78:32-34 accumulate available goods.
Grapes precede the full cup within one compact reward sequence, creating an ingestive relation without specifying the cup's substance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied coolness and drink, hot fluid, grapes, and a full cup; I infer that the focus fruit joins a reversal from coerced or absent ingestion to hospitable provision. The materially live alternative is that grapes and cup are independent abundance items, so no beverage-production claim should be made.

changed_reading.before: Grapes are primarily visual evidence of garden fertility.
changed_reading.after: Grapes also restore benign bodily reception within a sequence that reverses deprivation, hostile tasting, and withheld drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: Punishment is introduced as recompense matched to its object, while the reward catalogue containing the focus is closed as recompense, direct giving, and sufficiency. The garden and grapes therefore materialize a reward that remains answerable to recompense yet exceeds a merely transactional image through bestowed and ample provision.

activation_trace.role: The cultivated enclosure anchors abstract recompense in a durable bestowed place.
Fruit anchors gift and sufficiency in renewable concrete provision.
Recompense supplies the shared juridical frame on the punitive side of the contrast.
A measure equal to its counterpart supplies exact matching as the punitive qualifier.
The repeated recompense term carries the juridical frame across to the reward catalogue.
Direct giving overlays the recompense frame with bestowed generosity.
Sufficiency and enrichment supply adequacy that is not reducible to bare item-for-item matching.

structural_cues: The punishment formula at 78:26 and the reward formula at 78:36 bracket the transition and repeat جَزَآءً with different qualifiers.
The focus lies inside the positive catalogue that the later formula names both recompense and giving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared recompense language, exact matching on one side, and giving plus sufficiency on the other; I infer that the focus items embody an asymmetric generosity within judgment. A live alternative is that both outcomes are simply measured recompense and that عطاء and حساب add no contrastive surplus.

changed_reading.before: The garden and grapes are payment items in a balanced reward ledger.
changed_reading.after: They are concrete recompense recast as bestowed, sufficient provision rather than a narrowly equivalent payment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reactivates the eye and intense-looking branches beneath a noun whose immediate sense is gardens. It remains valid as a secondary resonance because both branches belong to the focus root and the surah moves from mutual questioning and disagreement to looking; downstream prose should present it as an ocular echo, never as a claim that حَدَآئِقَ lexically means eyes here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier is anchored in ح د ق at focus word 1, especially its eye and intense-looking branches, while grapes remain the visible object.

activation_trace.role: The eye branch opens a perceptual resonance inside the garden root without replacing its surface sense.
Intense looking turns the reward scene into something that compels direct attention.
Concrete vine fruit keeps the ocular activation attached to the visible focus scene.
Mutual questioning supplies the unresolved opening to which a visible answer can respond.
Divergent paths supply the disagreement that the manifest scene can end experientially.
Coming to know through disclosure supplies the shift from dispute to manifest recognition.
Directed sight at the close of the surah activates the focus root's latent gaze register.

changed_reading.before: The focus supplies objects that answer desire.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ocular resonance, the garden-and-grape scene also answers dispute by becoming abundance directly beheld.

strongest_changes: The garden and grapes became the mature output of a prepared water-to-growth system rather than a static reward inventory.
Garden enclosure became renewed spatial reliability after sky and mountains turn permeable or illusory.
The pair became the protected, sustaining geography of mafāz and successful arrival.
Grapes entered a bodily reversal from denied or hostile ingestion to full, hospitable provision.
The catalogue's closing formula recast the focus as recompense delivered through giving and sufficiency.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the focus answer several long arcs at once: earlier ecological production, cosmic boundary failure, opposed destinations, punitive deprivation, and the contrast between matched recompense and bestowed sufficiency. The non-focus eye and gaze branches of ح د ق also remained live as a carefully contained perceptual echo.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax may make the focus a specification of مَفَازًا or may simply continue an independent catalogue; the destination model does not require deciding this.
The proximity of grapes and the full cup supports a shared ingestive reversal but does not identify the cup's contents or derive them from the grapes.
The ocular model is branch-distant and should remain secondary to the enclosed-garden sense.
The regenerative sequence may function as analogy or recurrence rather than a single continuous causal history.
